source.title: 서울시 세출운용 사업 및 예산 정보
source.title_en: Seoul project budget and expenditure information
source.license: No use restriction stated by the official catalogue
source.transport_security: Official documentation uses HTTP on port 8088. An HTTPS probe on 2026-09-19 failed TLS negotiation. Because the API key is embedded in the URL path, production fetching requires the explicit SEOUL_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP=1 acknowledgement after security review.
source.export_note: The official portal's Excel download submits the page-issued CSRF token over HTTPS and does not require an API credential. Cloud probes 89e8eb37-b9aa-4e64-b8f1-2d5703cbb7f3 and 7d0c3088-220a-4986-bb69-2943829564e6 verified an XLSX with 4,593 contiguous numbered FY2025 project rows and eight published columns.
source.schema_notice: Ten fields were retired on 2026-05-26, including funding components, original appropriation and functional codes. The adapter accepts the retained name fields and amounts and preserves each complete source row.

entity.name: Seoul Metropolitan Government
excluded: public enterprise special accounts whose expenditure is accounted for separately
entity.scope_note: This source cannot represent the full UN Seoul built-up area. It excludes autonomous districts and institutions and does not consolidate governments outside Seoul's legal boundary.
